svg.title: One pebble on the pond
svg.desc: Left: the height field of a single source at 0.8 hertz after nine seconds, with the border sponge visible as the fading of the rings at the edge. Right: the amplitude envelope along a ray against the Hankel-wave prediction, a power of one half in radius times a decaying exponential.
svg.text: A single 100% CPU pebble at 0.8 Hz (exact scheme, 151 by 85 cells)
Crests orange, troughs blue. Wavelength 17.7 cells; the border sponge is the outer 10 cells.
Damping alone would give an e-folding length of 79 cells; geometric spreading adds the r^-1/2.
